ruling.recommended_action: Route to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review of the dangerous-driving allegation (speeding, hard braking, shoulder overtaking) and the driver's abusive written statement; advise rider of RydeHELP report path and, if injured, 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance claim. Consider account review of the driver's conduct under Code of Conduct.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the complaint alleges dangerous driving (SAFE-2); the driver's written statement contains abusive language toward the rider (SAFE-1). No automatic ruling permitted; needs human safety review. No telematics facts exist to verify the driving-manner allegation.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip claim that he drove normally and the rider was distracted is a statement, not a system record; it cannot rebut the dangerous-driving allegation and the abusive wording in it is itself a conduct issue.
